name: north-macedonia-tax-optimization
description: North Macedonia tax planning and regime comparison for calendar year 2026. Use for a sole trader considering assessed lump-sum taxation, actual-expense business taxation, expansion investment relief, genuine salary or company profit distributions. Covers the eligibility conditions and application timing of personal lump-sum assessment, the separate small-company turnover regime, salary-only personal reduction and the difference between company profit tax and shareholder income tax. Routes every proposed calculation to the current computational skill and requires evidence of the actual election, expenses, ownership, insured status and investment retention. Does not promise a saving, a self-employed contribution exemption, loss relief or a foreign treaty result. Supporting planning material for licensed professional review.
